title: Empire Files: How Palestine Became Colonized
summary: An Empire Files episode giving a timeline of Zionist settlement, the Nakba and Israel's expansion over Palestinian land, presented from a critical, anti-colonial viewpoint. It previews Abby Martin's reporting in Palestine.
why: HN commenters link it as a history of Palestine's colonization, though others dismiss it as propaganda.

quote.text: For those who are interested and want to construct their own opinion
